blocks.text: «Collective numerals are declined like adjectives in the plural, however in oblique cases they are usually replaced by the corresponding form of the cardinal numerals.» (L.98, p. 188) For **полтора**: «These forms are used for Nominative-Accusative only. For all other cases the form “**полутора**” is used for all genders.» (L.99, p. 193)
DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 98–99, pp. 188 and 193. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.
